prompts.odysseus_slide: Production sprite atlas for the exact Greek warrior Odysseus in the reference atlas. The supplied image is the identity, palette, rear-view camera and pixel-art style reference; make a new transparent asset. Landscape 1536x1024, 2 by 2 equal cells with completely empty transparent gutters, whole isolated body in each cell. Four sequential game poses for a forward knee slide under a very low beam. Every frame is seen FROM BEHIND, looking slightly down from a fixed third-person chase camera, looking the same direction as the rear run in row 2 of the source. Never show his face, front or a side profile. Preserve long wavy dark brown hair with golden rim, deep red ragged cloak over the back, bronze Greek cuirass and bracers, bronze greaves, black and brown leather skirt strips and sandals. Top left: runner drops into a deeply crouched braced position just as he begins the slide, left boot forward. Top right: sustained extremely low slide, hips close to the ground, right knee tucked, other boot extended forward in perspective, body folded forward, red cloak spreading slightly close to ground. Bottom left: same low sustained slide a moment later, cape and outstretched arms shift gently while head stays low. Bottom right: recovering from the slide, leaning forward and rising off one knee. Preserve the same body size across cells; the two low slide poses should naturally have a lower silhouette, not a smaller body. Center each pose in its cell, keep feet/ground contact at the same relative height near the cell bottom, do not clip any part of the cloak. Sharp hand-painted pixel-art silhouette matching the reference, no outline stroke, transparent alpha, no ground, no shadow, no VFX, no backdrop, no text, no border or extra props.
